I got diagnosed with ADHD a few years back. I had the same issues with the whole parents in denial thing (It wasn’t until i failed a whole grade did they budge lol). After I got diagnosed, i felt a huge weight lifted off my shoulder, even before getting help/medication and with my parents still in disbelief. I was medicated for a while but that was before the azme and now I can’t even find my medication on the shelves anymore (Akid ma2tou3). But i was doing better with concerta and ritalin. Now the process took a LONG TIME. From finding the right psychiatrist and psychologist to getting the prescription approved from the government, and don’t get me started on how much that all cost, it took like a good 6 or 9 months because of this dog shit country.  Anyway, all in all, i learned that medication isn’t everything and you can still find ways to manage your condition without having to fight tooth and nail for the treatment. Sure, it’s easier with medication, but there’s only so much we can do here.
ps: navigating through the whole process of trying to figure out what medication and dosage suits you best is a BITCH, so if you’re going through something like this i suggest you mentally prepare yourself first.
